briefdescription.para: Per-ring monomial layout / encoding helper used by F4GB.

detaileddescription.para: Holds the variable count nvars and the encoded monomial word width nslots, plus a per-variable hash table (hashfcn) and mask. Encoded monomials are laid out as [hashvalue, Computations, w_1, ..., w_r, e_1, ..., e_n] (or with the weights at the tail, depending on convention see in-source comments at the top of the file). Provides the operations the F4 inner loops need: compare, mult, divide, lcm, gcd, hash-with- component, plus encode / decode against actual exponent vectors.
